title: Making flamenco even more magical
text: We had an amazing experience with Maria. We got to see a part of Sevilla off of the tourist track. The class was excellent! It was perfect to do before we went to a flamenco show at the museum. We learned history, culture, some moves, and how the artists work together to create the experience for thr audience and for themselves. We loved Maria's stories that helped us learn about the dance. We highly recommend this experience!
author: Kathleen_G

title: flamenco with friends
text: This was great fun and really gave us a taste of the flamenco! Definitely recommend this experience, if you are curious about the history and how to do flamenco
author: Trip776192

title: Really Learn how to dance the Flamenco
text: This a truly exceptional experience.  I am not a dancer but the instructor did a fantastic job showing me the small details and the important steps. She gave a little history of the dance and showed me how to dance and feel strong at the same time.  I highly recommend learning to dance with Costanza!
author: alishag2019

title: Great family experience
text: Loved the Flamenco dance lesson with Maria. It made for a really nice family activity and experience on flamenco. Maria also made it fun with stories and kept it interesting. I also appreciated the provider being flexible and transparent in being able to reschedule our lesson to next day as our flight was delayed
author: SridharRa

title: Great Experience!
text: The dance lesson was awesome - a truly memorable experience.  Costanza was a great teacher and we would highly recommend her.  The show was fun also, but the real highlight was the lesson.
author: riteshsN4500SI

title: Fun immersive experience
text: Our teacher Costanza was so nice and patient and explained the important parts of the dance well. She was fun and gave us some simple choreography that we could do. Such a fun immersive experience. And then when you see the show you understand what they are doing a little bit more.
author: Carrie_D

title: Educational and cultural dance experience
text: The teacher was energetic and very easy to follow. We had a great time. We learned the basics of Flamenco and the choreography for one dance.
author: Monisha S

title: Gracias Maria!
text: Maria was a wonderful teacher, who also explained some things related to flamenco, to get you into the spirit and also get closer to the "theoretical" part. The practical lesson with choreography was super fun and interesting, I think the time available was used in the best way!
author: Stefyys

title: Intro to Flamenco
text: Costsnza did an outstanding job.  I am old and uncoordinated, but she was a great teacher and coach.  She had me dancing by the end of the session.  A must do if you like fire and passion,
author: JonT960

title: Family learns Flamenco: a trip highlight!
text: The Flamenco lesson was a fun way to enjoy family time and this cultural tradition. Our instructor could not have been better - a charismatic and accomplished professional with a gift for coaching varying levels of ability at one time. She made our experience enjoyable and meaningful, and the five of us are grateful for this shared memory. 10 out of 10!
author: Alicia_R
